bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
w=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 266f59805552cf77732fae92c683a6a1cd01b7c6
test -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' ai-core-model-gate)" = true
docker exec -i astera-v8 sh -c 'umask 077; cat >/tmp/gace_second_consumer_266f.js' < "$w/scripts/host_astera_second_consumer_probe.js"
key=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate sh -c 'printf "%s" "$AI_CORE_API_KEY"')
test "${#key}" -ge 16
rc=0
out=$(printf '%s' "$key" | docker exec -i astera-v8 node /tmp/gace_second_consumer_266f.js 2>&1) || rc=$?
unset key
case "$out" in *"AI_CORE_SECOND_PRODUCT_PROBE_FAILURE="*) outcome=NODE_PROBE_FAILED;; *'"authenticated":true'*) outcome=AUTHENTICATED;; *) outcome=UNKNOWN;; esac
printf 'ASTERA_SECOND_CONSUMER_RC=%s OUTCOME=%s\n' "$rc" "$outcome"
if test "$outcome" = AUTHENTICATED && test "$rc" -eq 0; then
 gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="AI_CORE_SECOND_CONSUMER_ASTERA_RUNTIME $out" --jq .html_url >/dev/null
else
 gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="AI_CORE_SECOND_CONSUMER_ASTERA_PROBE_FAIL EXIT=$rc CLASS=$outcome STDOUT_BYTES=${#out}" --jq .html_url >/dev/null
fi
